# Medical Doctor
1. Your direct superior is the Chief Medical Officer.
2. Medical Doctors should wear sterile gloves when dealing with patients to maintain sterility.
3. Patients should only be treated by a singular Medical Doctor at a time.
4. Medical Doctors are expected to ensure the patient’s wellbeing by providing good bedside manner, through conversation and inquiries about their accident.
5. Medical Doctors should work alongside new Medical Interns to show them the roles and responsibilities of the position.
